svg.aria-label: The method of the paper: thresholds fixed before the run, measure first behind a flag, the append only ledger, data as a hashed object, tests from the first day, the circuit breaker, the admission gate for claims, decisions and errors as dated records, and the collaboration between the researcher and the language model with the ledger as arbiter
svg.title: Figure 5. The method: an evidentiary discipline for single researcher work
svg.text: The method: an evidentiary discipline for single researcher work, reproducible apart from the architecture
quantum-cortex, original figure for section 2 of the paper. The discipline is held to be the primary reason the results can be trusted; it is stated here without the numbers it produced.
What a component and a claim go through, under the rules of §2.1 to §2.6

g.text: fixed before the run
thresholds fixed before the run, never
adjusted after; invariants written first
measured behind a flag
default off; the control bit identical
to the baseline, a test asserts it
committed to the ledger
a run not committed does not exist;
every abort a record too
read against the gate
the admission criteria, every one,
the sixth from the physics program
a result, or an open question
a finding that fails any criterion is reported
as an open question; losses are recorded
no component enters on the strength of an
argument; it advances only if an ablation, at
equal parameters, data, seed and schedule,
extends the frontier of declared axes;
components that do not clear the bar are
recorded as losses

svg.text: The ledger, and data as a first class object

g.text: each record follows a versioned schema validated
in continuous integration, with a configuration
hash and a content hash of the data mix; two runs
are comparable only when the content hashes of
their data mixes coincide; the mix is a hashed
graph of typed operators, evaluated lazily;
decontamination is an operator, its report archived

svg.text: Tests from the first day; the circuit breaker

g.text: structural invariants written before the
components they protect; the defects they caught
before any ablation are reported as method, not
incident; an aggressive early abort with a bounded
refine and retry, thresholds fixed before the run,
never adjusted after; every abort a ledger record
a finding enters a results section only if it is
measured on several seeds with the gap significant
under a paired test; situated against external
references at equal size; demonstrated on the real
task; reproducible from a committed artefact;
stated with its reserves. Adopted after a result
on a synthetic task shrank on the real one; the
retrogradation read as a result of the method

svg.text: Decisions and errors; the same discipline twice

g.text: every design decision is a dated record; amendments are
appended, never substituted, so that what was believed and
when is preserved; proposals from either party are hypotheses
to be tested, not conclusions. The author's parallel program
in classical gravitation converged on the same apparatus; one
result crossed over: the complete ledger observation, apparent
volatility of an invariant is the signature of an omitted variable,
became the gate's sixth rule

svg.text: The collaboration, designed so that two differently wired participants make their difference productive

g.text: the researcher: the upstream structure
which variables exist, which invariants must hold before
code is written, what a result must consolidate to count;
the structural checks, the gate; the over claims were
caught by the researcher's judgement: when generation is
cheap, the scarce step is judging what is true
the language model: rapid divergence and execution
variants, drafts, implementations, the literature at hand,
a first pass at every document; proposals from either
party are hypotheses to be tested, not conclusions;
the structure frames the generation, the generation feeds
the structure, the ledger arbitrates

svg.text: a design thinking discipline the author formalised earlier maps onto the rules: understand before defining the problem, define before designing; observe, contextualise, structure, empower, co create;

the register precedes any code and the protocols were frozen before a model existed that could pass them; a researcher with a strong upstream discipline and a generative partner, bound by a shared gate

g.text: the rules and the gate
what is run and generated
what is kept, admitted or reported
the records and the collaboration
